text.title: Ads Attribution Models Examples
text.summary: Reference tables the rules assume: the six models applied to one journey, platform default windows, lookback windows by sales cycle, source-of-truth options, and incrementality test designs.

section.title: The six models on one journey
section.p: Model comparison for a journey: FB click → Google click → Email click → Purchase

list.item: Last-click: FB 0% / Google 0% / Email 100% — conservative, ignores journey
First-click: FB 100% / Google 0% / Email 0% — awareness focus only
Linear: FB 33% / Google 33% / Email 33% — equal credit across all touches
Position-based: FB 40% / Google 20% / Email 40% — weights first and last touch
Time-decay: FB 10% / Google 30% / Email 60% — more credit to recent touches
Data-driven: ML-based — requires 50+ conversions/channel/month to train reliably

section.note: Same spend, six different CPA and ROAS readings; pick by sales cycle and volume (model-by-sales-cycle rule), then lock it.

section.title: Platform defaults

list.item: Meta: 7-day click, 1-day view (view-through counted)
Google Ads: last Google click, 30-day window
GA4: data-driven, 90-day window
LinkedIn: 30-day click, 7-day view (view-through counted)

section.note: These are the labels every comparison table column must carry (document-platform-defaults rule).

list.item: Impulse purchase (under 1 day): 1-day click window
Short cycle (1-7 days): 7-day click window
Medium cycle (1-4 weeks): 30-day click window
Long cycle (1-3 months): 90-day click window
Trust GA4 (data-driven): unified view, misses view-through — best for most teams
Warehouse-deduped: most accurate, requires ETL pipeline — best for $10k+/month spend
Trust platform data: detailed but over-counts — use only for within-platform optimization
Incrementality (geo-holdout): true causal lift — use quarterly to validate model

section.title: Incrementality test designs

list.item: Geo holdout: no ads in test regions, compare conversion lift vs. control
Conversion lift: platform-native measurement of lift over holdout
Ghost ads: control group sees placebo ads, not the tested campaign

section.note: Whatever the design: at least 4 weeks, budgets and targeting frozen (incrementality-four-weeks-frozen rule).
